name: jd-source-aware-legacy-nodes-and-diff-attribution
instr:
Let callers trace legacy JSON and YAML values through comparison and patching back to their exact input locations. Source attribution should remain useful across every collection interpretation and be available explicitly in library reports and legacy command output without changing ordinary behavior.

Located JSON and YAML decoding preserves ordinary JsonNode semantics while assigning every exposed value a stable source name and exact byte, line, and column span, including encoded JSON strings and YAML aliases. Line and column numbers are 1-indexed; byte and column ranges are half-open, with the end position one past the token. Values built from native Go data are explicitly synthetic at every native descendant, while supplied JsonNode children keep their provenance. Recursive object and ordered-list operations attribute logical values and occurrences as paths and indexes change, while preserving established object-key ordering. Set identity remains based on deduplicated content or configured object keys, and multiset identity remains count-based with distinct provenance for equal occurrences; location never affects equality or hashing. Every attributed DiffElement keeps OldSources and NewSources cardinality- and position-aligned with OldValues and NewValues, including synthetic values.
